data.name: p281-route-auto
data.yaml_source:
# #281 — provider chosen by the router from quota observations (Phase 5).
#
# The workflow names no vendor. `provider` is passed through to the routing/execution layer
# (p281/run-agent.mjs), which holds every vendor difference. Preloop governs the file write
# (MCP rules) and MLflow records the outcome through one shared step.
#
#   conductor run p281/workflows/auto.yaml
workflow:
  name: p281-route-auto
  description: Provider chosen by the router from quota observations; same Gate and record
  entry_point: route
  input:
    profile:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: research-default
      description: execution profile (config/profiles/<name>.yaml)
    file_name:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: routed.txt
    content:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: R1
  limits:
    max_iterations: 6
    timeout_seconds: 900

agents:
  - name: route
    type: script
    description: Collect quota observations and choose a provider (fail closed on HOLD)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/route.py", "{{ workflow.input.profile }}"]
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      provider: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
      evaluated: {type: string}
      model_route: {type: string}
      login: {type: string}
      profile: {type: string}
      evidence_dir: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: execute
        when: "{{ route.output.decision == 'ROUTE' }}"
      - to: record_hold

  - name: execute
    type: script
    description: Run the task through the routing/execution layer (acpx + Preloop)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/packages/auto/steps/execute.py", "{{ route.output.provider }}",
           "{{ workflow.input.file_name }}", "{{ workflow.input.content }}", "{{ route.output.model_route }}",
           "{{ route.output.profile }}", "{{ route.output.login }}"]
    timeout: 600
    output:
      status: {type: string}
      provider: {type: string}
      model_route: {type: string}
      run_id: {type: string}
      workspace: {type: string}
      target_path: {type: string}
      model_session_reported: {type: string}
      model_adapter_reported: {type: string}
      model_served: {type: string}
      measurements:
        type: object
        properties:
          total_tokens: {type: number, required: false}
          wall_ms: {type: number, required: false}
      approvals_requested: {type: number}
      mcp_rule_denials: {type: number}
      retryable_elsewhere: {type: boolean}
      evidence_dir: {type: string}
      ledger_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: check

  - name: check
    type: script
    description: Deterministic outcome check — the file, not the agent's account of it
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/packages/auto/steps/check.py", "{{ execute.output.target_path }}",
           "{{ workflow.input.content }}", "{{ execute.output.status }}"]
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
      file_exists: {type: boolean}
      content_matches: {type: boolean}
      file_sha256: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: record

  - name: record
    type: script
    description: Record the routed execution in MLflow (shared, vendor-neutral)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'execute': execute.output, 'check': check.output, 'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: done_pass
        when: "{{ check.output.decision == 'PASS' }}"
      - to: done_denied
        when: "{{ check.output.decision == 'DENIED' }}"
      - to: done_block

  - name: record_hold
    type: script
    description: Record the HOLD decision in MLflow — not starting is a result too
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: held

  - name: held
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "HOLD: {{ route.output.reason }}"

  - name: done_pass
    type: terminate
    status: success
    reason: "PASS: {{ check.output.reason }}"

  - name: done_denied
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "DENIED: {{ check.output.reason }}"

  - name: done_block
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "BLOCK: {{ check.output.reason }}"

output:
  profile: "{{ route.output.profile }}"
  route: "{{ route.output.decision }}: {{ route.output.reason }}"
  decision: "{% if check is defined %}{{ check.output.decision }}{% endif %}"
  provider: "{% if execute is defined %}{{ execute.output.provider }}{% endif %}"
  status: "{% if execute is defined %}{{ execute.output.status }}{% endif %}"
  model_adapter_reported: "{% if execute is defined %}{{ execute.output.model_adapter_reported }}{% endif %}"
  model_served: "{% if execute is defined %}{{ execute.output.model_served }}{% endif %}"
  mlflow_run_id: "{% if record is defined %}{{ record.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% elif record_hold is defined %}{{ record_hold.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% endif %}"
  record_error: "{% if record is defined %}{{ record.output.record_error }}{% elif record_hold is defined %}{{ record_hold.output.record_error }}{% endif %}"
